messages:
sec-oncall-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Suspicious KMS export attempt detected for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/primary at 2025-11-20T03:12:07Z. Audit log shows ExportCryptoKeyVersion RPC from serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Alice M: copying audit log snippet and creating incident channel. initiating war-room. who is oncall?
Bob T: I'm here. tagging sec oncall.
Carol-SRE: seeing same in Cloud Logging, unusual egress to 52.23.45.67 right after call.
Dave-Sec: confirmed. looks like service account made a call to projects/*/importCryptoKeyVersion. need to check RBAC change history for that SA.
Alice M: initial containment: 1) disable the service account key 2) revoke active tokens 3) set temp deny policy on KMS key 4) snapshot logs. doing 1 and 2 now.
Bob T: run commands? I can do GCP console, but paste the gcloud commands for audit evidence capture.
Alice M: paste: ```
# list recent KMS admin ops
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName: \"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.ImportCryptoKeyVersion\"" --project=redwood-prod --limit=50 --format=json
# disable service account
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-prod
# revoke by disabling the SA
gcloud iam service-accounts disable ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=redwood-prod
```
Dave-Sec: good. I've taken a forensic snapshot of the logs and exported to secure bucket gs://redwood-incidents/1768501234/. permissions restricted.
Carol-SRE: added temporary deny binding to the key via iam policy: ```
- members: ["serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
  role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
  condition: null
# replaced with explicit deny in org policy (applied)```
Bob T: FYI I see a config change in infra-repo PR #842 that added kms key access to CI role two days ago. suspect mis-scoped role.
Alice M: assign tasks: Bob -> review PR and revert mis-scope; Carol -> rotate affected key material and create new key version; Dave -> preserve forensic copy of the export payload and network flow; Eve -> comms + incident record update.
Bob T: I'm reverting the PR now and posting link to commit. ```git revert 1f2a3b4 && git push origin main```
Dave-Sec: got network PCAPs for the egress IP. I've submitted to SOC for attribution.
Eve-IncidentMgr: prepping customer/internal comms. no PII affected, but we need timeline and remediation notes for infra.
Alice M: status check: service account disabled ✅, deny binding applied ✅, PR reverted (in progress) ⚠️, key rotation queued ⏳.
Dave-Sec: found additional suspicious token issuance at 2025-11-19T22:48:11Z — looks like longer window. editing timeline.
Bob T: rolling back the PR created an automated workflow run; checking if any artifacts were published as part of CI.
Carol-SRE: starting key rotation. creating new primary key version and scheduling automatic re-encrypt. will update when done.
Alice M: evidence checklist: - logs exported to secure bucket - pcap uploaded - PR and commits captured - service account disabled - deny policy applied - key rotation initiated.
Eve-IncidentMgr: preparing handoff notes for next shift at 08:00 UTC. will include list of outstanding items and owners.
Alice M: handoff summary (to include in incident doc): 
- detection: KMS importCryptoKeyVersion call by ci-runner SA (2025-11-20T03:12:07Z)
- containment: SA disabled, deny binding on key, infra PR reverted
- evidence: logs + pcap in gs://redwood-incidents/1768501234/, ticket INC-2025-211 created
- outstanding: complete key rotation, validate no plaintext exfiltration, rotate any tokens/credentials associated with CI pipelines, run full RBAC audit for CI roles
- next steps: SOC attribution, legal review, customer outreach draft, post-incident remediation checklist (RBAC hardening + audit alerts)
Eve-IncidentMgr: tagging next oncall @carol and @frank to pick up at shift change. I'll drop final notes into Confluence and link here. :thumbsup:
Bob T: quick dev note — add a CI gating rule to block PRs that add kms admin roles without 2 approvals. I'll open a ticket.
Carol-SRE: key rotation completed, new key version ready. performing verification of services now.
Dave-Sec: SOC confirmed egress IP belongs to compromised CI runner VM in external partner account — coordinating takedown. more updates incoming.
Alice M: thanks team. documenting timeline, will attach logs and commands. handing off to Eve for post-incident coordination. :pray:
